description: Amalgamation of two existing flats into one larger single family dwelling, together with a first floor rear extension.
decision_conditions: <p>The roof of the rear extension hereby approved shall not be used as a terrace, balcony, or similar amenity area without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: In the interests of neighbouring amenities.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 1&nbsp;<span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bird</span> <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>, 1 swift bricks/<span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>, and 1&nbsp;<span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bat box</span>&nbsp;shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development. The details should include:<u></u><u></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 47.25pt; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><u></u><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Symbol;">·<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><u></u><span dir="LTR"></span>A minimum of 1 swift brick (same requirements for swift <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>) incorporated into the design of the development. They should be installed in groups of at least 2, and placed at or close <span class="m_-834678718698915799asgive">to</span>&nbsp;the eaves level of the development hereby approved. They should be placed at least 5m above the ground with a 5m unobstructed flight path, both below and in front of the swift brick. The swift brick should be located facing north, east, or north east <span class="m_-834678718698915799asgive">(direct sunlight should be avoided)</span> and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. <i>Where possible, swift bricks should be set flush into the external wall to match adjacent brickwork.</i><u></u><u></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 47.25pt; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><u></u><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Symbol;">·<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><u></u><span dir="LTR"></span>A minimum of 1&nbsp;<span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bird</span> <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>&nbsp;incorporated into the design of the development, with a variety of <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span> types (including different sized entrance holes) to provide habitat for diverse <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bird</span> species. The <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>&nbsp;should be installed at or close to the eaves level of the development hereby approved. The <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>&nbsp;should be between 3 and 5 metres from the ground, and there should be a clear flight path without any obstructions below and directly in front of the <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>. The <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">box</span>&nbsp;should <span class="m_-834678718698915799q6ibn">be facing</span> north, east or north east <span class="m_-834678718698915799asgive">(direct sunlight should be avoided),</span> and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il"><i>Boxes</i></span><i> located in the same area should not be placed too close together.&nbsp;</i><u></u><u></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 47.25pt; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><u></u><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Symbol;">·<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><u></u><span dir="LTR"></span>A minimum of 1&nbsp;<span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bat box</span>&nbsp;incorporated into the design of the development. <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">Boxes</span> should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">boxes</span> should be placed away from artificial light sources and i<i>deally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible. </i>The <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">boxes</span> should <span class="m_-834678718698915799q6ibn">be located facing</span> south, southeast or southwest, <span class="m_-834678718698915799q6ibn">and</span> exposed to sun for part of the day.<u></u><u></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0px; color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><b>Reason:</b><br>To support <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bird</span> and <span class="m_-834678718698915799gmail-il">bat</span> <wbr>populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity by providing nesting opportunities.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance, unless otherwise stated on the drawings hereby approved.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>
